Name: New NPC - Lumen from Arknights
Author: vickylchq
Description:
[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]这个Mod里有什么？What's in this mod? [/b][/size][/color]
因为奇妙的原因而远道而来的新角色——乔迪·方塔纳罗萨，代号“流明”。温柔谦逊但又不失坚韧的他，将在星露谷获得怎样的感悟？又会与你共同经历什么呢？
[list]
[*]流明作为不可婚（暂时）角色加入游戏
[*]300+ 日常对话
[*]9个好感事件
[*]6套季节性服装（冬季形象可配置）
[*]1个新物品
[*]属于流明自己的房间
[*]和流明成为朋友后，他会为你提供一个小小的便利……？
[/list][i]A new character, Jordi Fontanarrosa, codename "Lumen", has arrived in Stardew Valley for mysterious reasons. Gentle, humble, yet resilient, what insights will he gain here? And what experiences will you share with him?  
- Lumen joins the game as a non-romanceable NPC  
- 300+ dialogue lines  
- 9 heart events  
- 6 seasonal outfits (configurable winter appearance)  
- 1 new item  
- Lumen's own room
- Once you become friend with Lumen, he may offer you a small convenience...?  [/i]

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]我不认识流明！这个Mod还能玩吗？I don't know Lumen! Can I still play this mod? [/b][/size][/color]
Mod内的文本尽量写成了“没玩过明日方舟”也可以看懂的内容（至少我尽力了）。在配置中也可以选择“是否为明日方舟玩家”。
[i]The dialogues have been written in a way that players unfamiliar with Arknights can also understand (well at least, I did my best). You can also choose the "Are you an Arknights player?" option in the Config.[/i]

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]这个Mod可以中途安装和卸载吗？Can this mod be installed and uninstalled mid-game? [/size][/color][/b]
可以！
[i]Yes! [/i]

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]需要前置Mod吗？Are there any required mods? [/b][/size][/color]
必需[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b]和[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url][/b]。强烈推荐安装[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCG[/url][/b]。
[i]You must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCG [/url]is highly recommended.[/i]  

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]这个Mod与……兼容吗？Is this mod compatible with...?[/size][/color][/b]
我用我安装的700个Mod保证，本Mod兼容性很好，可以放心和Stardew Valley Expanded、Ridgeside Village、East Scarp等大型拓展Mod共同使用。（如果你同时拥有RSV或者ES，对话里会有少量联动。）
但是，鉴于我无法一一确认其他自定义NPC模组的设置，所以尽管我尽量避免了，但还是有可能出现如“节日站位重叠”之类的问题。如有发生，请告诉我。
另外，由于本Mod尽量只调用游戏已有的素材，因此可以和已安装的美化Mod自动适配。
[i]I can confidently say, with my 700 installed mods, that this mod has great compatibility! It works seamlessly with large expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp. (If you have RSV or ES installed, there will be a few crossover dialogues.)  
However, since I can't verify the settings of every custom NPC mod, issues like "festival position overlap" may still occur despite my efforts to prevent them. If you encounter any, please let me know.
Besides, since this mod primarily uses the game's existing assets, it should automatically adapt to any visual enhancement mods you have installed.

[/i][color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]适用于哪些平台/多人游戏可用吗？Which platforms is this mod compatible with? / Is it available for multiplayer?[/b]
[/size][/color]先说一声抱歉，因为我完全基于我的游戏（Windows 11，单人游戏）进行的制作，因此关于本Mod能否在其他操作系统、其他机型、多人游戏中正常运行，我无法做出回答。理论上讲它在这方面的兼容性应与其他使用相同依赖项的自定义npc模组完全相同。但是，如果有任何不兼容，我也无法在技术上进行修改，抱歉！
[i]Apologies in advance—I developed this mod entirely based on my own game setup (Windows 11, single-player). Therefore, I can't provide answers regarding its compatibility with other operating systems, different devices, or multiplayer game. Theoretically, its compatibility should be the same as other custom NPC mods that use the same dependencies. However, if any incompatibility issues arise, I won't be able to provide technical fixes. Sorry about that![/i]

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]支持哪些语言？Which languages are supported?[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]简体中文（原生）
[*]English（英语）（由ChatGPT和我翻译）
[*]Español（西班牙语）（由[size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/166107518]devy003[/url]翻译）[/size]
[*][size=2]Türkçe（土耳其语）（由[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106816238]shiizika[/url]翻译）[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106816238][/url][/size]
[/list]Mod内的所有文本都支持i18n，请随意翻译！
ps. 由于我最初是用中文写的，而中文显示在对话框中所占用的字符通常少于英语，因此英文版可能会出现“很长的台词却不断句”的情况，还请谅解！
[i]- Simplified Chinese (native)  
- English (translated by ChatGPT and me)  
- Español (Spanish) (translated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/166107518]devy003[/url])
- Türkçe (Turkish) (translated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106816238]shiizika[/url])
All texts support i18n, so feel free to translate!  
P.S. Since the original text was written in Chinese and Chinese takes up fewer characters in the dialogue box than English, some English lines might feel a bit long and lacking in breaks—hope you understand![/i]

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]如何安装？How to Install?[/size][/color][/b]
1. 下载压缩包
2. 在Mods文件夹中解压
3. 完成
[i]1. Download the zip file  
2. Extract it into the Mods folder  
3. Done [/i]

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]我在游戏里找不到流明/怎么才能触发事件？/流明喜欢什么？I can't find Lumen in the game / How do I trigger events? / What dose Lumen like?[/b][/size][/color]
Mod文件夹中包含写有流明的行程、事件触发条件、礼物品味的文档。欢迎查看！
[i]The mod folder includes documents detailing Lumen's schedule, event trigger conditions and gift tastes. Feel free to check it out![/i]

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]为什么是“不可婚”！Why is "non-romanceable"![/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][b][u]2.0版本将更新为可婚。[/u][/b][i]
[b][u]Version 2.0 will be updated to be marriageable.[/u][/b][/i][/color]

[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]后续……？Future updates...?[/size][/color][/b]
不确定有没有时间和精力进行更新。如果有更新的话，会是以下内容：
[list]
[*]将流明变为可婚角色（附带配偶房间和新服装等等）
[*]【已完成】真正属于流明的个人房间
[*]和更多Mod的联动，如[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url]﻿、[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aquaasa]萨卡兹系列mod[/url]﻿……
[*]新物品
[*]添加新事件用来欢迎（？）流明加入星露谷，而非只有现在的一封自我介绍信
[*]日语版本（如果没有翻译的话）
[/list][i]Not sure if I'll have the time and energy to update, but if I do, planned content includes:  [/i]
[i]- Making Lumen a romanceable character (with a spouse room, new outfits, etc.)  
- [FINISHED] A truly personal room for Lumen[/i]
[i]- More mod crossovers, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aquaasa]the Sarkaz series mods[/url]...  [/i]
[i]- New items 
- Added a new event to [i]welcome[/i] (?) Lumen to Stardew Valley, rather than just having the current introduction letter
- Japanese version (if there is no translation)[/i]
